title: If It Rains
label: ch:ta-if-it-rains
canDo: I can say what will happen if with vantāl and maḻai peytāl, say if after a noun with eṉṟāl, make an if less likely with oruvēḷai, and say even if (-ālum) and if not (-āviṭṭāl).

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 292: say what will happen if, even if and if not, with the if-form of a verb and eṉṟāl.
